comments.body: This is also dropped on higher level floors. I got it from the four enemy red aura statues on floor 130.

wiki:
Proof of Mythology (No.2) Memorial Album Item

How to obtain: Defeat "???" / Temple Guardian bosses in the Temple of Poseidon Endless Dungeon (only accessible from Acropolis of Atlantis if Atlantis is present on Maris server).

MPORTANT: you must have open slots in your inventory to receive the item drop for MA!

Drop rate: common (all dungeon bosses can drop this item)

Use: Equip as Land Battle item. Can be used to heal yourself and nearby fleetmates; essentially acting similar to Assorted Secret Elixirs but costing less Action Gauge (purple bar, lower right corner) points to use.
